title: Immunoprecipitation and Mass Spectrometry of HA-tagged Protein
author: Harper JW
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bqpfmvjn

steps.title: Harvest Cells
steps.instruction: Collect cells from plates and prepare pellets for storage or immediate use.

substeps.instruction: Wash plates 2x with cold PBS, then add 5 mL PBS per plate.
Gently pipette up and down or gently scrape to dislodge cells and homogenize.
Transfer to 15 mL conical tube and pellet cells at 3000 rpm for 5 minutes; discard supernatant.
Add 1 mL PBS and transfer to 2 mL tube.
Spin, aspirate PBS, and snap freeze pellet.
Store at -80 °C or use immediately.

steps.title: Lyse Cells
steps.instruction: Thaw and lyse the 293T cell pellets to extract proteins.

substeps.instruction: Quick thaw frozen 293T pellets in 2 mL tubes in a 37 °C water bath for approximately 3 seconds.
Transfer to ice metal block and add 1.2 mL MCLB.
Once thawed, pipette up and down to resuspend and tumble tubes for 20 minutes in the cold room at 4 °C.
Spin at 16.1 rcf for 20 minutes in pre-chilled bench-top centrifuges to clear lysate.

steps.title: Perform Immunoprecipitation
steps.instruction: Bind the HA-tagged protein to HA beads and wash the complex.

substeps.instruction: Reserve 25 µL - 50 µL of lysate for QC protein assay and western blot of input if desired.
Carefully transfer remaining supernatant to a fresh 1.5 mL tube containing 40 µL washed HA bead slurry.
Incubate cleared lysate with beads for 3 hours with tumbling in the cold room at 4 °C.
Spin samples at 3000 rpm, 4 °C, for 1 minute to pellet beads.
Carefully decant supernatant using an aspirator or 1 mL pipette.
Wash beads 4 times: add 1 mL MCLB to each tube, gently resuspend by shaking, spin at 3000 rpm, 4 °C, for 1 minute, and decant.
Wash beads 3 times in the absence of detergent: add 1 mL 50mM Tris/150mM NaCl (without NP-40), gently resuspend, spin at 3000 rpm, 4 °C, for 1 minute, and decant.
Carefully aspirate remaining wash buffer using a gel loading tip or P3111 capillary tips to get as close to the beads as possible.

steps.title: Elute HA-tagged Protein
steps.instruction: Release the protein from the beads using HA peptide elution buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL elution buffer (HA peptide elution buffer + 250 µg/mL HA peptide).
Incubate in shaker at 37 °C with gentle shaking for 30 minutes.
Collect bead eluate by centrifuging at 3000 rpm for 1 minute.
Repeat elution with an equal volume of HA peptide; incubate the second elution for 15 minutes.
Transfer eluate to labeled 1.5 mL tubes and freeze at -80 °C.

steps.title: TCA Precipitation and Acetone Wash
steps.instruction: Precipitate proteins and wash the pellet to prepare for mass spectrometry.

substeps.instruction: Add 55 µL neat TCA to samples (assuming 2 x 100 µL elution), vortex to mix, and gently spin to ensure TCA is not in tube caps.
Incubate either overnight at 4 °C or for 45 minutes on ice.
Spin at max speed (13000 rpm), 4 °C, for 30 minutes; carefully aspirate all but 30 µL of sample.
Wash pellet with 1 mL cold 10% TCA made in HPLC grade water; spin at max speed for 15 minutes and vacuum.
Wash pellet with 1 mL cold Acetone; spin at max speed for 10 minutes and vacuum.
Repeat the Acetone wash 2 more times (total of 3 acetone washes).
Air dry or use speedvac to dry the pellet completely; DO NOT HEAT.

steps.title: Trypsin Digestion
steps.instruction: Digest the precipitated protein pellet into peptides.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend dried pellet in 40 µL 200mM EPPS (pH 8.5)/10% Acetonitrile (digest buffer).
Spot check pH with 0.2 µL of sample to ensure pH 8.5.
Add 100 ng trypsin (Thermo) per sample (Stock: 1 µg/µL). Prepare a master mix of trypsin digest buffer and add 40 µL to each sample. Do not vortex.
Incubate at 37 °C for 6 hours (warm room or thermomixer, gentle shaking allowed).
Acidify with 2 digest volumes of 5% formic acid in HPLC grade water (e.g., add 80 µL for a 40 µL digest).
Spot check pH for a couple of samples to ensure pH 2.

steps.title: Final Analysis
steps.instruction: Proceed to stage tip followed by analysis by mass spectrometry.
